versions.content: The TPS_ECUConfiguration shall provide naming conven- tions for public symbols. Type: valid Description: The TPS_ECUConfiguration shall provide naming conventions for public symbols. This especially includes requirement ids, module abbreviations, meta data and configuration symbols used in the document of a release. Rationale: Avoid ambiguities and name clashes inside the specification. Provide a consistent uniform presentation of meta data to the reader of the specification. Allow automatic processing of specification elements. Use Case:  Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
